guarantees.claim: b[0] is continuously assigned the value of q XOR ss_a1_a0
b[1] is continuously assigned the value of b_buf[0] XOR ss_m1_m0
b[2] is continuously assigned the value of b_buf[1] XOR mul_a1_a0_buf
b[3] is continuously assigned the value of b_buf[2] XOR mul_a1_m0_buf
b[4] is continuously assigned the value of b_buf[3] XOR mul_a0_m1_buf
b[5] is continuously assigned the value of b_buf[4] XOR mul_m0_m1_buf

assumptions.claim: The signal q must be independent of a1 and a0, as stated in the comment.
assumptions.risk: If q depends on a1 or a0, the masking scheme may be broken, potentially leaking secret information via power or EM side-channels.

assumptions.claim: The output b (or specifically the value seen on b[0]) is assumed to be independent of m1 and m0, as implied by the comment on line 309.
assumptions.risk: If b depends on m1 or m0, masking could fail and expose secret state through side-channels.

uncertain_points.claim: The comments assert that q is independent of a1,a0 and that b[0] does not depend on m1,m0. These properties are not enforced locally; verification of upstream logic (generation of q, ss_a1_a0, ss_m1_m0, etc.) is required to guarantee the masking integrity.
uncertain_points.risk: A violation of the claimed independence could create a first-order side-channel leakage, compromising the secret key.
